The Trustworthy AI™ approach
As everyone sprints into AI, few are watching their step. Reputations are at risk
and trust is more important than ever. Trustworthy AI™ is Deloitte’s integrated
approach to building AI that is safe, secure, compliant and scalable, so you
can unlock its limitless potential, while protecting what matters most.
Contact Us
Agentic AI Report
Dream big, sleep easy
Dream big
With world-class engineering talent focused on safety and security as a building block for creating value with AI, and proprietary behavioral science targeting adoption at scale, you can afford to dream big.
Sleep easy
Risk is our native language. When others started asking “How can we use AI?” We were already asking “How can we make it trustworthy?”. Bias, improper training, reputational risk? It’s time to find something else to keep you up at night.
The trust effect
Making progress is hard without trust. Especially when you’re integrating technology that’s developing at speeds never seen before. Levels of trust can be a predictor of success in your efforts to unlock value with AI, so let’s embed it from the start.

Agency in the agentic age
The fast-changing AI landscape makes our adaptive Trustworthy AI
™️
approach more impactful with every wave of development. AI agents don’t just perform tasks, they identify, plan and execute them with a higher degree of autonomy than familiar AI tools. This introduces new risks and challenges for organizations and makes embedding trust at a foundational level more important than ever. To have agency in the agentic age you need to trust that you’re in control.
Agentic AI Report
Embed trust across your AI lifecycle
The Trustworthy AI™ approach integrates products and services that span multiple disciplines. With you, we connect the dots across data, technology, people and process to embed trust for competitive advantage powered by AI.

Insights, expertise, and opportunities
Insights and actions on SB53: Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act
SB53, signed into law, is the first state law in the US to regulate developers of frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models.   Taking effect on January 1, 2026, it includes safety guardrails, incident reporting, whistleblower protections, and other compliance requirements, with penalties for non-compliance. Learn more.
From trust to action - Navigating risk in the age of agentic AI
The emergence of AI agents, which not only perform tasks but also identify, plan and execute them with a higher degree of potential autonomy than familiar AI tools, calls for a renewed emphasis on established elements of the Trustworthy AI ™ Framework. It also introduces new risks and challenges for organizations to confront.
Generative AI trust actions correlate with better risk management and bigger rewards
Deloitte AI Institute - AI Insights
The Deloitte AI Institute helps organizations transform through cutting-edge AI insights and innovation by bringing together the brightest minds in AI services.

Insights and actions for AI compliance under foreign entity restrictions
The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) introduced new restrictions on foreign influence within the artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain. These requirements place a heightened emphasis on due diligence, supplier certifications, and risk management processes for organizations leveraging AI technologies1. As regulatory expectations evolve, organizations must proactively address foreign influence risks to maintain compliance.
